comment: Optional M01 supply spaces through normal human movement. The confiscation alcove holds a medkit and, in its south pocket, the secret Shiv; the maintenance overlook holds armor. Nothing here is required by either route.

states.name: confiscation_alcove
states.note: A recessed medkit beside the property lockers rewards a deliberate detour. It is not required by either route.

states.name: secret_shiv_found
states.note: Stepping into the alcove's south pocket finds the Shiv. One quiet SECRET FOUND corner line, and the blade is drawn in hand.

states.name: shiv_thrust
states.note: A cut spends nothing: the blade thrusts toward the crosshair and settles, with no muzzle flash or tracer.

states.name: back_to_bay
states.note: The pocket is a walking return to the bay route.

states.name: overlook_cache
states.note: Optional armor occupies the quiet landing corner, away from the required walking route.

states.name: maintenance_overlook
states.note: The low rail frames the service stair and machinery. The authoritative armor claim is covered by the cache lifecycle test.

states.name: return_to_route
states.note: The detour returns to the existing records approach without a jump or gate.
